reviewer: Claude (visual inspection of crown/trunk closeups, textures inspected)
notes: v1 = the in-game veg_4 pine and spruces. Total 33,828 tris for six trees (5.0-6.8k each); budget is set per tree.

defects.text: Snow spruce shows almost no snow: the card has only a few pale specks on the needle tips, it reads as a plain spruce.
defects.fix: New snow card with heavy clumped snow on the needles.

defects.text: Pine foliage is sparse pale needle specks on long thin ferny flat sprays; the crown is thin and see-through, reads as a yew or fern, not a Scots pine with dense needle clumps.
defects.fix: New dense needle-brush card; shorter, droopier cards in 4 per position; heavier limbs.

defects.text: Pine trunk is one brown bark tone, a perfectly straight pole; Scots pine shows grey-brown plates low and orange flaking bark above, and a twisted trunk.
defects.fix: Two-tone trunk (grey-brown lower 50 percent, orange flaking above), more bend.

defects.text: Spruce: branch tiers are sparse and regular so the bare trunk shows through the middle; the leader is a flat star of cards instead of an upright tip.
defects.fix: Wider cards, more branches per whorl, tighter whorl spacing, upright leader.

defects.text: Root flare dips 0.85 m below z = 0 (sits-on-ground warning).
